label: Node handles GDPR or facilitates the customer handling GDPR
description: This node provides GDPR data subject rights (export, delete, rectify) directly, or surfaces an API that lets the customer fulfill them. See [GDPR DSR overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/compliance/regulatory/gdpr-data-subject-requests).

label: Node does not store data in GDPR scope
description: This node does not store data in scope for GDPR

label: Calling service is responsible for GDPR export / delete
description: This node is a processor only. The calling service must propagate DSR requests and ensure end-to-end fulfillment.

label: Unknown
description: Unknown handling. This is a placeholder until more information is known.
